manifest.selection: Fixed settings frozen before supplemental ML scores; exploratory model comparison, no tuning on test folds

scope: Development-set model comparison. Conditional held-out clocks and retrospective area; sealed cycles untouched. Best among tested settings, not a certified global winner.
